def createparser():
    """Create the argument parser for the pysemver command-line interface."""
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        prog='pysemver', description='Work with Semantic Versioning strings.')
    parser.add_argument('--version', action='version', version=__version__)
    commands = parser.add_subparsers(dest='command')

    compare_parser = commands.add_parser('compare', help='Compare two versions')

    bump_parser.add_argument('version')

    check_parser = commands.add_parser('check', help='Check a version string')
    check_parser.add_argument('version')
    return parser


def process(args):
    """Process parsed CLI arguments and return the command result.

    Invalid versions raise ValueError. The check command returns no output
    when its version is valid.
    """
    if args.command == 'compare':
        return compare(args.version1, args.version2)
    if args.command == 'bump':
        return globals()['bump_' + args.part](args.version)
    if args.command == 'check':
        parse(args.version)
        return None
    raise ValueError('No command specified')
